findings: Nine child gardening decision URLs absent from the main XML sitemap before this pass; they have distinct live canonical pages and nine explicit shell routes.
Nine child pages (eight in national-planting and one in national-frost) had overlong titles and an author reference with no Person definition in their own JSON-LD block.
Gardening Hub and its 12 distinct cards already carry a defined Person; preserve hub and original intent owners.
National-planting build pipeline injects Google tag and AdSense publisher loader into all eligible emitted HTML; authenticated AdSense serving/revenue remains NOT AVAILABLE.
Sitemap and snippet repairs are crawl/discovery improvements, not evidence of indexing, traffic lift or ad earnings.
New pages launched after the measured 28-day baseline; do not describe missing prelaunch impressions as confirmed zero traffic.
